title: Questions before starting a project with us.

items.question: What does {company} do?
items.answer: {company} is a creative production studio in Malaysia. Our speciality is video podcasts: we record at your location on multiple cameras and edit each episode into a full video plus short clips. We also produce videos and photography, and handle design, websites, digital marketing and branding.

items.question: Can you handle several services in one project?
items.answer: Yes. Many clients combine services, for example a podcast with short clips, event photography and social media posts, or a new brand identity with a website. One team handles all of it, so everything stays consistent.

items.question: Do I need a studio to produce a podcast or video?
items.answer: No. We come to you: we record at your office, venue or event, or in a location we arrange for you, anywhere in Malaysia.

items.question: Do you work with government agencies and corporate clients?
items.answer: Yes. {company} is registered with MOF and recognised by FINAS and FDAM. We work with government bodies, corporate teams, SMEs, brands and creators across Malaysia.

items.question: Do you produce video podcasts and short clips?
items.answer: Yes. We record on 2 to 5 cameras with wireless mics and professional lighting. Then we edit a full episode, colour graded and subtitled with a custom thumbnail, plus short clips for social media. We also produce livestream podcasts.

items.question: Can you build or redesign our website?
items.answer: Yes. We build fast, mobile-friendly websites and landing pages, and can produce the photos, videos and copy that go on them.

items.question: Can you manage our social media and marketing?
items.answer: Yes. We plan content, manage social media and run ad campaigns, using the videos, photos and designs we produce for you.

items.question: How do I book a consultation?
items.answer: Fill in the form on this page or message us on WhatsApp. The consultation is free. Tell us what you want to produce and when you need it, and we will suggest the right approach.
